summary: Tested freemium usage limit system. Found and fixed a bug where recipe generation requests weren't being properly detected, bypassing the quota check. All 10 backend tests pass, frontend correctly shows UpgradeModal when limit is reached.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug in is_recipe_generation_request() - was checking for 'Please suggest' but frontend sends 'Create 4 ORIGINAL' format. Removed the 'Please suggest' requirement to properly detect [User Preferences] messages.
seed_data_creation: Test user already has 5/5 recipes used today
context_for_next_testing_agent: Freemium usage limit system fully tested. Backend returns correct usage status (tier, used, limit, remaining, reset_at). 403 is returned when limit exceeded with proper error structure. Frontend shows UsageLimitBanner at top of chat page and UpgradeModal when 403 received.

recipe_limit_enforcement.status: Working - returns 403 with feature_locked error when at limit

UsageLimitBanner.displays: Daily recipe limit reached, Resets in X hours, 5/5 used

UpgradeModal.displays: Daily Limit Reached modal with upgrade options
UpgradeModal.triggers: On 403 response when trying to generate recipes

bugs_fixed.issue: is_recipe_generation_request() checked for 'Please suggest' but frontend sends 'Create 4 ORIGINAL' format
bugs_fixed.fix: Removed 'Please suggest' check, now only checks for '[User Preferences]' marker
bugs_fixed.impact: Recipe generation was bypassing quota check, allowing unlimited recipes even when at limit
